import pandas as pd

# Load the intermediate joined table from the given path
intermediate_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_99/intermediate_step1.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(intermediate_path)

# The intermediate table schema matches the target schema exactly:
# ['PassengerId', 'Survived', 'Pclass', 'Name', 'Sex', 'Age', 'SibSp', 'Parch', 'Ticket', 'Fare', 'Cabin', 'Embarked', 'Fare_x', 'Fare_y']

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema:
df['PassengerId'] = df['PassengerId'].astype(int)
df['Survived'] = df['Survived'].astype(int)
df['Pclass'] = df['Pclass'].astype(int)
df['Name'] = df['Name'].astype(str)
df['Sex'] = df['Sex'].astype(str)
df['Age'] = df['Age'].astype(float)
df['SibSp'] = df['SibSp'].astype(int)
df['Parch'] = df['Parch'].astype(int)
df['Ticket'] = df['Ticket'].astype(str)
df['Fare'] = df['Fare'].astype(float)
df['Cabin'] = df['Cabin'].astype(str).replace('nan', pd.NA)
df['Embarked'] = df['Embarked'].astype(str).replace('nan', pd.NA)
df['Fare_x'] = df['Fare_x'].astype(float)
df['Fare_y'] = df['Fare_y'].astype(float)

# Save the final target table to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_99/target_multisource.csv"
df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source table with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_99/training_0.csv", index_col=0)

# The target schema has columns:
# ['PassengerId', 'Survived', 'Pclass', 'Name', 'Sex', 'Age', 'SibSp', 'Parch', 'Ticket', 'Fare', 'Cabin', 'Embarked', 'Fare_x', 'Fare_y']
# The source table has only one table, so to get Fare_x and Fare_y, we join the table with itself on PassengerId

# Perform inner join on PassengerId
df = source0.merge(source0, on="PassengerId", suffixes=('_x', '_y'))

# The join duplicates all columns except PassengerId, so the schema matches target exactly

# Write output to target file
df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_99/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
